title: Try Omarchy: Run Omarchy on MacOS without any setup
description:
Try Omarchy packages the Omarchy Linux desktop as a native Mac app for Apple Silicon, running through Apple's Hypervisor Framework with Metal doing the rendering. It shares your Mac's camera, clipboard, and network ports with the guest OS. This fork's pitch is idle cost: total idle CPU dropped from 71 percent of a core to 15, mostly by moving interrupt handling into Apple's hypervisor. 

https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy
